name: Air Conditioning, Heating and Ventilating
description: Includes all fans, hoses, thermostats, ductwork, etc., associated with the environmental control of the vehicle cab.

name: Cab and Sheet Metal
description: Includes all cab and sheet metal required to cover the major equipment components. Includes all integral bodies and pickup-type beds normally supplied by equipment manufacturers. Also includes reflectors, mirrors, seats and interior cab equipment. Does not include special bodies such as dumps and containers.

name: Instruments, Gauges, Warning and Shutdown Devices, and Meters
description: Includes all instruments, gauges (pressure and rotary) warning and shutdown devices, and meters that are integral to the components of power units.

name: Aerodynamic Devices
description: Includes all fairings, stabilizers, and other devices designed to reduce drag and buffeting. Applicable to power units and trailers.

name: Axles, Non-Driven, Front
description: Begins at, but does not include, the front springs and includes all components up to, but not including, the wheel bearings. Applicable to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Axles, Non-Driven, Rear
description: Begins at, but does not include, the rear springs and includes all components up to, but not including, the rear hubs and bearings. Applicable to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Brakes
description: Begins at the brake pedal and includes all plumbing, valves, air compressor and controls up to and including the brake drums. Applicable to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Frame
description: Includes all structural members of the frame, bumpers and necessary brackets/mounts required for attaching components. However, suspension brackets are not included as part of the frame. Applicable to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Steering
description: Begins at the steering wheel and includes all steering components up to, but not including, the spindle or steering knuckle.

name: Suspension
description: Begins with, and includes, the brackets attaching the suspension to the frame and includes the parts necessary to attach the suspension to the axle. Applicable to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Tires, Tubes, Liners and Valves
description: Includes tires of all types, tubes, liners, and valve assemblies. (Tire costs of mounting, removal, repair and maintenance are an operating expense and should not be charged to the maintenance account.) Applicable to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Wheels, Rims, Hubs, Bearings
description: Includes only wheels, rims, hubs wheel bearings and seals. Applicable to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Undercarriage
description: Specific to equipment equipped with tracks, such as a bulldozer, or related off-highway equipment. Includes the track, rollers, idlers, tensioners, sprockets, shields/guards, equalizers, and pivot shaft mechanism.

name: Stabilization
description: Specific to equipment equipped with retractable stabilizers, such as used on utility or tree-trimming trucks. Includes the feet/pads, hydraulics, controls, supports and locks.

name: Axles, Driven, Front Steering
description: Includes the axle assembly beginning with the front spring pad through, but not including, the wheel hub and bearings, and includes the differential drive flange or yoke.

name: Axles, Driven, Rear
description: Begins at, but does not include, the rear springs and includes all components up to, but not including, the wheel hub and bearings. Includes the differential drive flange or yoke.

name: Clutch
description: Includes all clutch drive or driven members including the controls. Does not include the flywheel.

name: Driveshafts
description: Includes all driveshafts, universal joints, and support bearings between the component drive flanges or yokes.

name: Transfer Case
description: Includes case, cover and all internal parts and controls. Begins at the input shaft and ends at the rear output shaft flange.

name: Transmission, Main, Manual
description: Includes the transmission case, cover and all internal parts and controls. Begins with the main drive gear and ends at the rear flange or yoke. Does not include parts found in the Auxiliary section.

name: Transmission, Main, Automatic
description: Includes the transmission case, cover, and all internal parts and controls. Begins with the main drive gear and ends at the rear flange or yoke.

name: Auxiliary Transmission
description: Includes the transmission case, cover and all internal parts and controls. Begins with the main drive gear and ends at the rear output shaft flange.

name: Auxiliary Section, Main Transmission, Manual
description: Includes the transmission case, cover, and all internal parts and controls. Begins with the auxiliary drive gear and ends at the rear flange or yoke.

name: Final Drive
description: Includes sprockets, gears, and yoke.

name: Charging
description: Includes all on-board components and wiring necessary for charging of batteries for both internal combustion and electrically propelled vehicles. Does not include batteries or gauges.

name: Cranking
description: Includes the starting motor, necessary piping, wiring, relays and switches (excluding combination ignition or accessory switches) including the system power source which is normally a battery. The cranking system includes both electrical and air operated circuits.

name: Ignition
description: Begins with the ignition switch and includes all components through the spark plugs. It includes all components and wiring in both the primary and secondary circuits.

name: Lighting
description: Includes all wiring, bulbs, switches and wiring harnesses necessary to illuminate the vehicle.

name: Supplemental Information Devices
description: Includes collision avoidance systems and other related safety devices.

name: Modules/Relays - Electrical
description: Includes modules and relays with multiple applications.

name: Air Intake
description: Includes all items between the air inlet port through the intake manifold (excluding carburetor).

name: Cooling
description: Begins with the radiator and covers all components up to and including the water pump. Also includes water manifold and temperature control devices.

name: Exhaust
description: Begins with the exhaust manifold and extends through the end of the tailpipe.

name: Fuel
description: Includes the fuel tank through the carburetor or fuel nozzle and covers all fuel lines, pumps, filters and controls.

name: Powerplant
description: Includes the basic power plant of internal combustion engines and internal power plant lubrication system. It does not include any of the above systems (Air intake, cooling, exhaust or fuel).

name: Electric Propulsion
description: Includes the basic electric propulsion motor and its controls, and the system power source (normally an electric battery).

name: Filter Kits (Multi-piece)
description: Filter kits used with Systems 041-046.

name: Powertrain - Electric, Hybrid
description: Parts specific to hybrid-electric powertrains.

name: Hydrogen Fuel Cell
description: Parts specific to hydrogen fuel cells.

name: LNG Engine Fuel System
description: Parts specific to liquid natural gas engine fuel systems.

name: CNG Engine Fuel System
description: Parts specific to compressed natural gas engine fuel systems.

name: General Accessories
description: Includes such items as hubodometers, tachometers, recorders, etc. Applies to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Electrical Accessories
description: Includes clocks, batteries, and battery boxes for auxiliary equipment, radio receivers and transmitters, cassette players, CD players, etc. Applies to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Expendable Items
description: Includes equipment fluids, gases, and particulates as well as such items as chains, flares, fire extinguishers, paint, etc., which are not normally considered as being part of equipment maintenance. Applies to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Horns and Mounting and Reverse Signal Alarms
description: Includes all wiring, piping, controls and mounting devices.

name: Cargo Handling, Restraints and Lift Systems
description: Includes all equipment-mounted cargo handling devices such as conveyors and on-off loading mechanisms, cargo restraints, and all lifting devices such as power tailgates, power masts and booms, slides, rams, dump mechanisms, etc. Applies to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Power Take Off
description: Includes the following types of power take off units and all related components: front driven, transmission driven, auxiliary transmission driven, belt driven.

name: Spare Wheel Mounting
description: Includes all brackets, mounting plates, and securing devices

name: Winch
description: Includes all brackets, mounting plates, and securing devices. Applies to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Vehicle Coupling
description: Includes all vehicle coupling devices, controls and necessary mounts. It includes the fifth wheel and pintle hooks.

name: Auxilary Power Unit (APU)
description: Includes all components specific to auxilary power units used for powering driver comforts onboard the vehicle.

name: Onboard Lavatory
description: Includes all components associated with an onboard vehicle lavatory including water closet, sink and supporting fixtures.

name: Stationary Generator
description: Includes all parts specifc to the stationary generator such as motor, alternator, battery, belts, control panels, circuit breakers.

name: Medical Devices
description: Includes all parts specific to medical devices used in a sleeper cab environment such as a Continuous Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP) machine.

name: Terminal Equipment - Multi-Applications
description: Includes those systems integral or attached as accessories to terminal equipment and not found to be appropriate for assignment under other vehicle system codes.

name: Satellite Communications Sys.
description: Includes satellite/mobile communications equipment.

name: Hydraulic Systems
description: Includes those hydraulic systems not otherwise specified.

name: Scrapping
description: Applies to blade and/or scrapping attachments, including the blade assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Buckets
description: Applies to bucket attachments (manlift and/or loading), including the bucket assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Lifting
description: Applies to any lifting attachments, including boom assemblies, fork lift masts, poles, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Conveyence
description: Applies to conveyence attachments, including roller assemblies, belts, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Sweeping
description: Applies to broom attachments, including the roller assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Spreading
description: Applies to spreader attachments, including the spreader assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Chipping
description: Applies to chipper attachments, including the chipper assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Blowing
description: Applies to blower attachments, including the blower assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Vacuuming
description: Applies to vacuum attachments, including the vacuum assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Trenching
description: Applies to trencher attachments, including the trencher assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Tilling
description: Applies to tiller attachments, including the tiller assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Mowing
description: Applies to mower attachments, including the mower assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Ripping
description: Applies to ripper attachments, including the ripper assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Raking
description: Applies to rake attachments, including the rake assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Breaking
description: Applies to breaker attachments, including the breaker assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Hammering
description: Applies to hammer attachments, including the hammer assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Grappling
description: Applies to grapple attachments, including the grapple assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Magnets
description: Applies to magnet attachments, including the magnet assembly, wearable items, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Drilling and Boring
description: Applies to drilling and boring attachments, including the feeding assembly, boom structure, frame, motor, rod holder, flushing assembly, hammer, auger, cable and wench, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Pulling
description: Applies to pulling attachments, including the sheaves (or cables and pulleys), hoist drum, winches, bucket, boom structure, pedestal, knucle, sprockets, leveling assembly, shields and guards, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Dust and Debris Collection
description: Applies to dust/debris collection attachments, including the holding container, filtration, hydraulic, support and control assemblies.

name: Weighing and Measuring
description: Includes assemblies pertaining to onboard weighing and measuring systems.

name: Paving
description: Includes assemblies specific to paving equpment.

name: Crushing
description: Includes assemblies specific to crushing equipment.

name: Compacting
description: Includes assemblies specific to compacting equipment.

name: Body (Except Bulk Carrier Body)
description: Includes side and front walls, roof assembly and/or tarpaulin bows for van bodies, posts and rails for stake bodies, flooring or decking, side door, bolsters and holddowns, lining, sealing, insulation and related hardware and special attachments (Meatrails, rivets, tappets, etc.)

name: Rear Wall and Door
description: Includes rear wall and supports and rear door(s) with all hardware for attaching, operating, or support along with heavy-duty framing around periphery of doors.

name: Shell - Tank Vessel, Inner
description: Portion of vessel which can be in direct contact with flowable cargo. Includes aerator, bulkheads, baffles, sumps, and slope sheets, but does not include manholes, piping, nipples or valving.

name: Jacket - Tank Vessel, Outer
description: Includes light gauge protective cover over insulation, insulation coolie heads, and supporting framework.

name: Manholes
description: Opening in tank shell for access, inspection or loading. Includes collar or flange in vessel along with cover and attaching hardware.

name: Rings and Bolsters
description: Structural or supporting members at the inner shell periphery.

name: Trailer Frame and Support
description: Begins at the frame and includes the upper coupler, support frame, platform chassis framing, upper subframe, lower subframe, slider mechanism, spring hangers, vertical supports, leg assembly, dolly, turntable, and ends with either the footpads or wheels.

name: Trim and Miscellaneous Hardware
description: Includes hose carriers, fenders, underride guard, ladder, walkway, tarps, and carrier, plenum cover, deflectors for gravel, and tire carrier. Applicable to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Safety Devices
description: Includes all components designed to protect the structural integrity of the vessel.

name: Mixers
description: Includes the drum, booster axle, chutes and hydraulic, support, frame, control, water supply, and drive assemblies.

name: Compaction Bodies
description: Includes the container body, compaction assembly, trim and miscellaneous parts, and the loader, ejection, hydraulic, support, control and frame assemblies.

name: Tilt Bodies
description: Includes the body or bed, boom, winches/cables, and the hydraulic, support, control, frame, roller, and tarp assemblies.

name: Bus Body
description: Includes window, storage and entry/egress assemblies.

name: Emergency Vehicles
description: Includes parts specifically tailored for fire, rescue and emergency equipment.

name: Recreational Vehicle
description: Includes parts specific to recreational vehicles such as refrigerators, heaters, bedding, tables, entertainment systems, etc.

name: Heating Unit
description: Includes all coils or appliances either structurally incorporated into the vessel or mounted in the cargo space to maintain a given temperature range. Applicable to Power, Trailers, etc.

name: Refrigeration, Mechanical
description: Includes the evaporator, expansion valve, compressor, thermostat, engine or PTO, condenser, receiver, liquid line dryer, heating-defrosting, control panel and all refrigeration lines pertinent to the system. Applicable to Power, Trailers, etc.

name: Refrigeration, Nitrogen
description: Includes the fill body, container, piper guard, sensing bulb guard, control unit, emergency switch, emergency shutoff valve, safety vent-door, spray header, and all refrigeration lines pertinent to the system. Applicable to Power, Trailers, etc.

name: Refrigeration, Holdover Plate
description: Includes the holdover plate, console panel, and condensing unit. Applicable to Power, Trailers, etc.

name: Blowers, Conveyors and Vibrations
description: Begins with product intake and includes intake air filter, lubrication system, housing and mounting frame and ends with the product discharge outlet. The blower may be either tractor or trailer mounted

name: Compressor, Bulk Product Transfer Systems
description: Begins with product intake and includes intake air filter, lubrication system, housing and mounting frame and ends with the product discharge outlet. The compressor may be either tractor or trailer mounted.

name: Lines, Tubes, Hoses — Fittings, Bulk Product Transfer Systems
description: Includes all air and commodity conveying lines and hoses, couplings, and attaching components integral to the vessel for both loading and unloading. Does not include valves or manifolds.

name: Manifold
description: Includes inlet and outlet fittings along with product control devices and supporting brackets.

name: Powershaft - Power Take Off
description: Begins at the PTO and includes the driveline, universal joints, and the support bearings between component flanges or yokes and ends with coupling device to either the pump, blower or compressor.

name: Pump - Product Transfer
description: Begins with the product intake and ends at discharge outlet.

name: Valves and Controls - Bulk Product Transfer Systems
description: Includes all air, hydraulic or mechanically operated valves which regulate or direct the transfer of air or cargo. Also included are any remote controls for the operation of these valves. Does not include the manifold.

name: Safety Devices, Instruments and Gauges
description: Includes all relief and check valves, fusible and frangible discs, as well as mounting nipples and other devices used to measure and report, but audible or visual means, safety-related conditions such as pressure and temperature conditions, etc.

name: Batch Mobile Processing Plant
description: Includes the material hopper, scale, hydraulics, support, controls, frame, water supply, material heater, material drier, loader, additive mixture pumper, mixer, pnuematic, drive, tilt shielding, and exterior protection assemblies.

name: Belt Conveyor System
description: Includes rollers, bets, hydraulic, support, controls, frame, pulleys, motors, bearings, wipers, skirting, pnuematic, safety, catwalk, drive and external protection assemblies.

name: Bucket Conveyor System
description: Includes the bucket, chain, hydraulic, support, controls, frame,catwalk, drive and external protection assemblies.

name: Screw Conveyor System
description: Includes the screw, flight, hydraulic, support, controls, frame,catwalk, drive and external protection assemblies.

name: Roller Conveyor System
description: Includes the roller, hydraulic, support, controls, frame, catwalk, drive and external protection assemblies.

name: Chain Conveyor System
description: Includes the chain, pulleys, motors, gears, hydraulic, support, controls, frame,catwalk, drive and external protection assemblies.

name: Paddle Wagon, Drag Chain Assy.
description: Includes the paddle wagon, motors, cylinders.

name: Processing Screens
description: Includes screens, bearings, motors, chain/belt drives, trommel assembly (used in recycling equipment).

name: Dairy Pumping Unit
description: Includes main pumping assembly, sampler assembly, air eliminator vessel, hoses, reels, cabinets, valves.

name: Concrete Pumping Equipment
description: Includes main pumping assembly, drums/vessels, hoses, reels, cabinets, valves.

name: Oil Shaker Box
description: Includes shaker assembly, motors, switches, and pump.

name: Fuel Metering
description: Includes meter assembly, cables, hoses, probes, valves.

name: Automatic/Manual Chassis Lubricator
description: Includes control system, necessary plumbing, wiring, fittings and fasteners. Applicable to Power Units, Trailers, etc.

name: Electric Power Management - Electric Vehicle
description: Parts for managing power on electric vehicles.

name: Electric Drive Components - Electric Vehicle
description: Parts for drives on electric vehicles.

name: Bulk Storage System
description: Includes the container vessel, piping, hydraulics, support, controls, frame, aeriation, gates, scale, ladder, ventilation, platform and turn head assemblies.

name: Roll Off, Lugger Bodies
description: Includes parts specific to equipment that transports and disposes of refuse.

name: Air Compressor System
description: Includes compressor, motor, hydraulic, support, control, frame, reservoir, plumbing, filtration, couplers, lines, hoses and safety devices for an air compressor system used as an equipment-dependent attachment.

name: Deicing
description: Includes assemblies specific to deicing equipment.

name: Sawing
description: Includes assemblies specific to sawing equipment.

name: Milling
description: Includes assemblies specific to milling equipment.

name: Arrow Board
description: Includes parts specific to road directional/instruction displays.

name: Insulating Lift Equipment
description: Includes assemblies specific to insulating lift equipment.

name: Insulating Drilling and Boring
description: Includes assemblies specific to insulating drilling/boring equipment.

name: Glider Kit
description: Includes all components other than the engine and chassis used to restore a vehicle to like new condition.

name: Total Vehicle
description: Represents the entire vehicle or piece of equipment as a whole.

name: Powertrain - Hydraulic, Hybrid
description: Parts specific to hybrid-hydraulic powertrains.

name: Painting and Spraying
description: Assemblies specific to painting and spraying equipment.

name: Rolling
description: Includes assemblies specific to rolling equipment.

name: Digging
description: Includes assemblies specific to digging equipment.

name: Chassis Shipping Unit
description: Includes parts specifically tailored for shipping intermodal container chassis.
